Choose a portrait direction after answering three questions

Primary request: editorial artwork for Professional Headshot from a Photo, showing careful portrait lighting and a natural professional presence.
Scene/backdrop: a small refined portrait studio vignette on a calm deep slate field.
Subject: a single freestanding warm-paper portrait print showing an invented adult with a naturally friendly face and navy jacket; a broad softbox on the left and a curved warm-paper backdrop frame the portrait, with one small orange adjustment dial on the lamp stand. The portrait is a dimensional paper illustration, clearly cover art rather than an actual customer photograph.
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration, sculpted paper and matte ceramic, restrained realistic studio shadows, crisp purposeful detail.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape, central crop-safe composition with generous negative space, all essential elements within the central 80%, legible at 290-pixel card width.

Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, watermarks, product UI, vendor branding, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling. No glossy glamour effects or science-fiction glow.
